title: fix(ui-core): evaluatePlainCondition reads a bare-string predicate as CEL, as evaluateCondition does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

Fixes #27605

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc names `evaluatePlainCondition` (repo grep over `skills/`, `content/`, `docs/`: 0 hits); the CEL teaching for bare predicates is #27587's

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@object-ui/core` 对外导出的 `evaluatePlainCondition(condition, record)` 把「裸字符串」条件按 CEL 求值，与 `evaluateCondition` 走同一个 CEL 引擎；只有 `${…}` 模板仍走旧 JS 求值器。
- 为什么改：spec 把裸字符串定义为 CEL 简写，服务端和控制台其余谓词路径（#27584 之后）都按 CEL 读；这个导出却还按旧 JS 语法读，调用它的宿主拿到的是另一种方言。
- 风险与回滚：只依赖 JS 语法的裸字符串（`===`、`.includes()`、`.length` 等）现在返回 false，原来能算出 true；仓内除自身测试外零调用方（实测见下）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/ExpressionEvaluator.ts`（`evaluatePlainCondition` 函数体）、`ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/ExpressionEvaluator.test.ts`（`describe('evaluatePlainCondition')`）、`.changeset/27605-plain-condition-cel.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/ExpressionEvaluator.test.ts`，预期 88 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `evaluatePlainCondition` (`@object-ui/core`, published through `evaluator/index.ts`): a bare string now goes to `ExpressionEvaluator.evaluateCondition(condition, { throwOnError: true })`, which since #27584 evaluates a bare string on the canonical `@objectstack/formula` CEL engine (`evaluateCelCondition`). The evaluation context is unchanged (`{ ...record, data: record }`), so both `status` and `data.status` resolve in CEL.
- The function's fault policy is kept: `throwOnError: true` turns a CEL fault into a throw, which the existing `catch` answers with `false`; a non-boolean result answers `false` (the engine seam already compares `=== true`). A blank condition answers `false` as it did before, by an explicit guard, because `evaluateCondition` answers a blank gate `true` ("no gate").
- A `${…}` template is unchanged: `evaluate(condition, { throwOnError: true }) === true` on the legacy engine.
- Changeset `.changeset/27605-plain-condition-cel.md`: `'@object-ui/core': minor`, both declaration lines, a BREAKING note that teaches the CEL spelling with no FROM-TO list and no console-only escape hatch, ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` as in the precedent's changeset.

## Why

`@objectstack/spec` defines a bare string in a predicate slot as `{ dialect: 'cel', source }` (the string arm of `ExpressionInputSchema` in `packages/spec/src/shared/expression.zod.ts`), the server reads it on CEL, and #27584 moved every console predicate path to CEL. This export was the one public reader left on the legacy JavaScript grammar (contract review of #27584, should-fix 3; triage graded it align, not retire).

## Tests

All in `ExpressionEvaluator.test.ts`, `describe('evaluatePlainCondition')`:

- Rewritten pin: the compound case now uses the CEL spelling (`amount > 1000 && status == 'urgent'`), true and false legs.
- New: CEL-only constructs evaluate (`status in [...]`, `size(tags) > 0`), each with a true and a false leg.
- New: a JS-only spelling is refused with `false` where the JS grammar would have answered `true` (`===`, `.includes(`), each beside its CEL control (`==`, `.contains(`) answering `true`, and no console line.
- New: `data.amount > 1000` as a bare CEL predicate.
- New: parity, six source and record pairs, `evaluatePlainCondition` equals `new ExpressionEvaluator({ ...record, data: record }).evaluateCondition(source)`.
- New: a `${…}` template still reads `===` on the legacy engine.
- New: a blank and a whitespace-only condition answer `false`.
- Kept: field reference, numeric comparison, template `data.` reference, invalid syntax, non-boolean result.

## Acceptance notes

- Narrowing, declared `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` / `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` as the claim and the precedent (#27584) do: a bare string that only the JS grammar reads now answers `false` from this export.
- Caller sweep at `d93d9be5` (`git grep evaluatePlainCondition` over the whole tree, `ui/` and `packages/` included): 0 callers outside its own file and its test file. Sibling repositories (HotCRM, cloud) were not measured: NOT MEASURED, out of this card's scope.
- Blank condition: kept at `false` (unchanged), so it deliberately differs from `evaluateCondition`'s diagnosed "no gate" `true`; this export answers "does the condition hold", and a blank one never did. Pinned.
- No console line on a fault, as before: the `throwOnError` route passes `warn: false` to the engine seam, so the answer `false` is the whole report. Pinned.
